summary: Tiny 6 m kerb on cul-de-sac bulb, too short for a van.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 15-17 m away with more all round the bulb.
drivers.access_and_room: Section is 6 m, shorter than a van; the bulb is tight around the island.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park by the island, but not on this stub.

sun_shade: Island trees shade from the south-east; open otherwise.
